title: Reject duplicate bone indices within a vertex skinning influence set
description: LinearBlendSkinning enforced the maximum influence count and finite/non-negative weights but accepted repeated BoneIndex values within one vertex. Repeated indices are redundant representation: they consume one of the four authored slots while being algebraically equivalent to a single combined influence. More importantly, accepting them allows upstream binders to violate the intended one-slot-per-bone contract without detection. Enforce distinct bone indices at the low-level deformation boundary and add a focused regression. Keep weight normalization behavior unchanged for distinct influences. This is a small invariant hardening, not a new weighting policy.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implemented in LinearBlendSkinning.Deform with a bounded nested comparison across the preceding influence slots. This was deliberately chosen over a per-vertex HashSet after adversarial hot-path review caught the extra heap allocation that HashSet would introduce. Added LinearBlendSkinningDuplicateInfluenceTests.Deform_DuplicateBoneIndexWithinVertex_Throws. No Unity validation was run in this harness.
